subject.title: fix: tighten readSchema.limit from Type.Number to Type.Integer

question: Should the session read tool continue accepting fractional numeric limits and normalize them at execution, or should its model-facing schema reject fractions?
rationale: Current main intentionally accepts numbers for both pagination fields and normalizes `limit`, while this PR’s title argues for a stricter contract but its actual diff locks in the existing one.

options.title: Keep the numeric compatibility contract
options.body: Retain Type.Number-based inputs and, if desired, accept this only after renaming the test and PR to describe normalization rather than schema tightening.

options.title: Adopt strict integer input separately
options.body: Close or replace this test-only PR with a narrowly scoped schema-contract change that documents upgrade behavior and preserves existing non-positive normalization semantics.

recommendation.title: Keep the numeric compatibility contract
recommendation.body: Retain Type.Number-based inputs and, if desired, accept this only after renaming the test and PR to describe normalization rather than schema tightening.
